question: ‘Sericulture’ is related to the:
solution:
The correct answer is the __**rearing of silkworms.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sericulture is related to the **rearing of silkworms.**
 
• Sericulture is an** agro-based industry.**
 
• It involves the **rearing of silkworms for the production of raw silk.**
 
• India is the **second-largest producer of silk** within the globe.
 
• Silk is a fiber made up of **two different proteins:**
 
 
• **Sericin protein**
 
• **Fibroin protein**
